cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you catch that bus: yesterday you said work kept you till six. Why is your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I went home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down; the lift still stands. Tell me where you stopped before we go.

reason: Make the disputed journey explicitly yesterday and the offered ride current; A preserves B transport while keeping the missing destination as the condition for ending the conversation.
